item.title: U.S. Department of Energy Launches the Genesis Open Models Initiative
item.description:
📝 Models should have transparent provenance. DOE opened the Genesis open-weight models contribution portal today, hosted by the Genesis Mission US Open Models Initiative at https://genesisopenmodels. Contributing to Genesis Open Models The program is seeking scientific and technical materials for several stages of model development.
🔗 Read more: https://genesisopenmodels.anl.gov/
